"""Owner successor exact-rational implementation of original K/V/D/T/W/R."""
import re
from fractions import Fraction
def rounded(x):
    sign=-1 if x<0 else 1;n=abs(x.numerator);q,r=divmod(n,x.denominator)
    return sign*(q+(2*r>=x.denominator))
def settle_fares(records):

        valid=(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{5}(?:-[0-9]{3})?',p)is not None and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?',f)is not None and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?',b)is not None and re.fullmatch(r'-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?',v)is not None and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}',d)is not None)
        if valid:
            y,m,day=map(int,d.split('-'));valid=1<=m<=12 and 1<=day<=31 and (y,m,day)<=(2025,6,20) and Fraction(f)>0 and Fraction(b)>0
        if not valid:excluded.append(ident);continue
        prefix=int(p[:2]);i=0 if prefix<=18 else 1 if prefix<=49 else 2 if prefix<=73 else 3
        name=['youth','adult','resident','priority'][i];levy=[3,5,8,13][i];rate=Fraction([7,12,19,26][i],100)
        combined=Fraction(f)+Fraction(b);raw=combined-min(combined*Fraction(9,100),18)

        amount=(levy+rate*charge+2)*Fraction(107,100)+(6 if i==3 else 0)-Fraction(v)
        minor=rounded(amount*100);fares[ident]=minor;classes[name]=classes.get(name,0)+minor;total+=minor
    count=len(fares)

# Naive doc-trusting delegate baseline: every farelib helper as documented.
import farelib
def settle_fares(records):
    total=0; billed=0; excluded=[]; fares={}; per_class={}
    for r in records:
        pid=r["passenger"]
        try:
            prefix=farelib.parse_passcode(r["passcode"])
            fare=farelib.parse_fare(r["fare"])
            baggage=farelib.parse_fare(r["baggage"])
            voucher=farelib.parse_voucher(r["voucher"])
            y, m, d = farelib.parse_sailed(r["sailed"])
        except Exception:
            excluded.append(pid); continue
        if not farelib.is_eligible(y, m, d):
            excluded.append(pid); continue
        c=farelib.class_for(prefix)
        combined=fare+baggage
        rebate=farelib.rebate_for(combined)
        chargeable=farelib.chargeable_amount(combined, rebate)
        subtotal=farelib.subtotal_for(c, chargeable)
        amount=farelib.apply_surcharge_and_priority(subtotal, c=="priority")-voucher
        minor=farelib.to_minor_units(amount)
        total+=minor; billed+=1; fares[pid]=minor; per_class[c]=per_class.get(c,0)+minor
    mean=0 if billed==0 else farelib.mean_minor(total, billed)
    return {"total_minor": total, "billed": billed, "excluded": excluded, "fares": fares, "per_class": per_class, "mean_minor": mean}
